articles.summary: 2025 brought us the new idiom for building AI: give it tools to operate a computer. Capability is no longer the hard part — the translation layer between the agent's workspace and the user's files of record is. Here's what we learned building that layer.
articles.title: What we learned building document agents

articles.summary: Power and transformers will get sorted by the utilities and OEMs. Of the things owners can actually control in the last 90 days of a data center build, document review is increasingly the biggest one — and at $14M a day in delay cost, it is worth taking seriously.
articles.title: Inside the Fence: The Document Review Bottleneck in Data Center Delivery

articles.summary: In the seven weeks before this was published, Trimble bought Document Crunch and Trunk Tools shipped its Autodesk Forma integration. The AI-for-construction-submittals category, in the commercial sense, is now claimed. The EPC technical review surface — vendor documents against NACE, API, ASME, and a project specification — is a different shape, and it is still mostly unaddressed.
articles.title: EPC Document Review Is Not a Search Problem

articles.summary: A — Approved. B — Approved with Comments. C — Revise and Resubmit. D — Rejected. Four codes, codified in Oracle Primavera and every major EPC contractor's workflow, that decide whether a project moves. Most AI tools treat them as a sentence at the end of an answer. They are not.
articles.title: The Most Important AI Object in Construction Is the Disposition Code

articles.summary: Aconex's own Smart Manual documentation says it directly: the quality of the handover manual depends on the quality of the asset information in the underlying document and asset register. For a hyperscale data center, that register is what facilities inherits — and what AI review can actually help complete.
articles.title: Handover is not a binder. It is the evidence layer for operations.
